decisions.reason: The height-adjustable executive desk line fits the post-pandemic demand for flexible, representative workplaces, so its value is still being realized and keeping it costs relatively little.
The chair family sits close to the core offer and shares its production and sales channels, so the cost of holding it stays low while it supports the living and office ranges.
Floor cushions from carpets remain a niche accessory with uncertain pull, but they reuse rug materials at low holding cost, so the option is kept while it is watched closely.
The high standing table complements the conference and office range at little incremental cost, and modern workplace layouts continue to support its value.
The rug collection is the firm's strategic flagship toward broader interiors, and its growth option is worth keeping open despite its distance from the core offer.
